mentions.name: AppImage Installer with Custom Icons
mentions.description: This application helps install AppImages and lets users set a custom icon for each AppImage, addressing cases where apps ship with the wrong logo or icon.
mentions.problem: Some apps come with the wrong logo/icon.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an application that will help me install AppImages. The problem I'm solving is that some apps come with the wrong logo/icon. So in the app I'm building we'll be able to set a custom icon for the AppImage.
